mission: Determine whether an ordered completed-clock phase transition supplies a broad quiet structural XSP landmark family without weakening the frozen excursion-scale oracle.

predecessor.reason: The three-profile-stable family passed every frozen breadth gate except quiet structural DOWN, which had 17 events against the unchanged floor of 20; quiet UP had 29.

quiet_transition_law.universe: RTH candidate episodes emitted by the unchanged five-clock causal phase-front owner after all 5m, 15m, 30m, 60m, and 120m clocks are ready
quiet_transition_law.clock: completed five-minute observations only; missing historical seconds and ETF transport are never synthesized
quiet_transition_law.opening_boundary: the required 120m clock warmup naturally excludes the opening family; P-002C remains the opening, pressure, shock, and GTH landmark owner
quiet_transition_law.regime: every candidate observation from repair spark through terminal must be ORDINARY under the existing prior-only SPY same-RTH-slot volume and normalized-TR rank law
quiet_transition_law.candidate_origin: the unchanged phase owner begins only when both fast-clock velocities persist in the direction opposite the incumbent structural-slope majority
quiet_transition_law.persistent_velocity_arrival: both 5m and 15m velocity arrivals plus at least one 30m, 60m, or 120m arrival must be recorded in nondecreasing fast-to-slow order
quiet_transition_law.slope_cascade: both fast slopes and at least two structural or slow slopes must cross in the candidate direction with ordered causal arrival timestamps
quiet_transition_law.recoil: a direct ordered cascade is one class; if recoil occurs, explicit REACCELERATION must precede the terminal cascade
quiet_transition_law.terminal: SLOW_SLOPE_CASCADE under unavailable historical transport is the morphology-only terminal; RELAPSED, incomplete cascade, pressure-contaminated, underwarmed, and right-censored episodes remain named controls
quiet_transition_law.economic_meaning: unproved causal opportunity landmark only; qualification does not assert a profitable pivot, direction permission, trade, or captured excursion
quiet_transition_law.future_aware_oracle_join: none during P-002Q count; future price, excursion, serious label, return, MFE, MAE, and crown outcomes stay sealed

next_stage_law.on_pass: freeze one categorical atlas that assigns P-002C scale consensus to opening, pressure, shock, and GTH while P-002Q owns quiet mechanism-defined transitions; only then may one bounded economic replay open
next_stage_law.on_fail: record the structural count failure and preserve P-002C; do not weaken ORDINARY, arrival order, recoil survival, a count floor, or the censor gate
